topic: Introduce a new cat to a resident cat
core_question: How do I introduce a new cat to my resident cat without conflict? (secondary: How do you fix a fridge that isn't cooling like it should?)
answer_summary: Keep the new cat isolated at first, swap scents via bedding, allow sniffing under a door, then use gradual supervised visual introductions before full face-to-face contact.; after the topic shift: Unplug the fridge, locate the condenser coils (usually behind or underneath the unit), and vacuum or brush off the built-up dust and debris, since dirty coils are the most common reason a fridge stops cooling efficiently; also check that the door seal isn't damaged.
persona: polite but increasingly frustrated; chatty and verbose
